deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: Schedule deletion of this member account. New bookings are blocked as soon as you confirm.
deletion.ruleTitle: What is erased and what is kept
deletion.ruleBody: Account-scope data is erased: your profile, notification preferences, and consents that are not tied to a session (for example marketing). Booking-scope consents — the ones that authorised a session — are de-identified (your name and account are removed) and kept for the Portuguese clinical-record minimum, then destroyed later. Expert clinical notes follow the same retain-then-destroy rule. This cannot be shortened from this screen.
deletion.grace: There is a 14-day waiting period before deletion runs. You can cancel during that window.
deletion.confirmBody: This schedules deletion. Account-scope data will be erased. Session-linked consents are de-identified and retained for the legal clinical period. Future and unpaid sessions are cancelled. Paid sessions are marked for a later refund.
deletion.cancelled: Account deletion cancelled. You can book again.
